req.title: Task creation persists
req.statement: The system shall commit new task rows so subsequent GET calls return them across requests.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-021 requires that POST /tasks/ commits new task rows so subsequent GET calls return them. I design: (1) a positive EP test that POSTs a valid task, checks 201 + exact payload fields, then GETs by ID and verifies persistence; (2) a negative NEG test that POSTs with a missing required field (title) and asserts exactly 422; (3) a BVA test at the title length boundary (1-char min, 100-char max, 101-char over-max) to catch off-by-one mutations on Field constraints; (4) a STC test verifying the state transition from non-existent to persisted (GET 404 before POST, 200 after); (5) a DT test covering the completed boolean both True and False to catch boolean-negation mutations. All tests use in-process TestClient with SQLite in-memory override to remain deterministic and idempotent.

actions: POST /tasks/ with title='Read chapter 5', description='Signal pulse', completed=false

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app.models import Base

engine_mem = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
SessionMem = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem)

def override_get_db():
    db = SessionMem()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_task_persists_and_get_returns_exact_payload():
    payload = {"title": "Read chapter 5", "description": "Signal pulse", "completed": False}
    r_post = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r_post.status_code == 201
    data = r_post.json()
    assert data["title"] == "Read chapter 5"
    assert data["description"] == "Signal pulse"
    assert data["completed"] == False
    assert isinstance(data["id"], int)
    task_id = data["id"]
    r_get = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    got = r_get.json()
    assert got["id"] == task_id
    assert got["title"] == "Read chapter 5"
    assert got["description"] == "Signal pulse"
    assert got["completed"] == False

test_post_task_persists_and_get_returns_exact_payload()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app.models import Base

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem4)

    try:

    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db4
client4 = TestClient(app)

def test_post_task_state_transition_nonexistent_to_persisted():
    r_before = client4.get("/tasks/1")
    assert r_before.status_code == 404
    r_post = client4.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Book flight tickets", "completed": True})
    assert r_post.status_code == 201
    created = r_post.json()
    assert created["title"] == "Book flight tickets"
    assert created["completed"] == True
    task_id = created["id"]
    r_after = client4.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_after.status_code == 200
    fetched = r_after.json()
    assert fetched["id"] == task_id
    assert fetched["title"] == "Book flight tickets"
    assert fetched["completed"] == True

test_post_task_state_transition_nonexistent_to_persisted()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app.models import Base

engine_mem5 = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
SessionMem5 = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem5)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem5)

def override_get_db5():
    db = SessionMem5()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db5
client5 = TestClient(app)

def test_post_task_completed_boolean_both_values():
    r_true = client5.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Renew gym membership", "completed": True})
    assert r_true.status_code == 201
    d_true = r_true.json()
    assert d_true["completed"] == True
    id_true = d_true["id"]
    g_true = client5.get(f"/tasks/{id_true}")
    assert g_true.status_code == 200
    assert g_true.json()["completed"] == True
    r_false = client5.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Organize desk", "completed": False})
    assert r_false.status_code == 201
    d_false = r_false.json()
    assert d_false["completed"] == False
    id_false = d_false["id"]
    g_false = client5.get(f"/tasks/{id_false}")
    assert g_false.status_code == 200
    assert g_false.json()["completed"] == False
    r_filter_true = client5.get("/tasks/?completed=true")
    assert r_filter_true.status_code == 200
    ids_true = [t["id"] for t in r_filter_true.json()]
    assert id_true in ids_true
    assert id_false not in ids_true

test_post_task_completed_boolean_both_values()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
